title: fix(plugin-report,plugin-dashboard): report, chart and table drills list the records a filtered measure counted
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuUdRNQVD3k9LXPSp1pEBp9r)_
Fixes #30615

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：报表（表格行、小计行、矩阵单元格）和看板（图表、表格、交叉表）的下钻，现在除了点中的分组和组件/报表筛选，还会叠加服务器给的该度量范围（drillScopes），点开列出的就是数字统计的那些记录。
- 为什么改：带条件的度量（如「已付款发票数」）以前点开会列出整个分组的记录，数字是 0 却列出 4 张发票，读者会不再信任看板。
- 风险与回滚：只动 plugin-report 和 plugin-dashboard 的下钻；没有范围条目的度量（派生度量等）和没有 drillScopes 的应答不再给下钻；一行里多个度量范围不一致时改为按单元格下钻。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx 的 openDrill、表格行/单元格和 chartDrillMeasure；ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx 的 drill / drillCell；两个新的小文件 measureDrill.ts、measureDrillScope.ts。
- 两分钟验证：打开 app-showcase 的 Revenue Pulse (filtered) 看板，在 Paid Rate by Status 表的 Sent 行点 Paid Invoices（0），抽屉应为空；点同一行的 Invoices（4），应列出 4 张 sent 发票；Paid Rate 单元格不可点。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The drill composes three legs, not two.** The list filter is the clicked bucket AND the widget or report filter AND the answer's `drillScopes` entry for the measure the click stands for (PR #30596's sidecar). A `{}` entry hands the widget or report filter back untouched, so a drill on an unfiltered measure is byte-identical to the drill it was before.
- **What a click stands for.** A chart mark: its series' measure (a pivoted chart: its one measure; a mark with no series key: the one measure a single-series chart draws; a `MEASURE__compare` series: nothing, it has no entry). A cross-tab or matrix cell: its column's measure. A table row, a report line or a subtotal line: every measure it holds.
- **A table row whose measures select different records drills cell by cell.** When every measure of the row shares one scope, the row drills as before (`dataset-drill-row`). Otherwise the row is not a drill target, and each measure cell with an entry is (`dataset-drill-cell`), drilling that measure's records. This is the case on `table_rate_by_status`: `invoice_count` (`{}`) beside `paid_count` (`status = paid`).
- **No list that does not match the number** (the #30080 ruling, comment 6631202970). A measure with no entry (derived, or a scope naming a relationship path) is not clickable; neither is anything on an answer that carries an `object` but no `drillScopes`; a chart none of whose drawn measures has an entry gets no click handler.
- `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/measureDrill.ts` (new, internal): `sharedMeasureDrillScope` and `scopeDrillFilter`, reading entries with the merged `readMeasureDrillScope` from `metricDrill.ts` (unchanged). `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/measureDrillScope.ts` (new, internal): the same two plus `measureDrillScope`, since plugin-report does not depend on plugin-dashboard. Neither is exported from a package entry; `@object-ui/core` is untouched.
- One root changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-report` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, patch.

## Why

A dataset number is computed under the dataset's `filter`, the measure's `filter` and the widget filter. The drills composed only the last one with the bucket, so a filtered measure drilled to a superset. The server now states the missing two per measure (PR #30596); the KPI tile reads them since PR #30634. This PR makes the report, chart, table and cross-tab drills read them too.

## What the drill does when the answer has no `drillScopes` (the reading the claim asked for)

- Measured on the server: `queryDataset` sets `drillScopes` on every dataset answer that has rows (`analytics-service.ts`, the block after the drill ranges). It is absent on (1) an answer with no rows, where there is nothing to click; (2) a draft-preview answer, which returns before `dimensionFields`, `drillRawRows` and `drillRanges` are set, so the widget's `canDrill` is already false there, and the Studio report preview passes no `onDrill`; (3) a cube query answer, which these consumers never request (they call `queryDataset` only).
- So on every answer a current server sends, "no `drillScopes`" never meets a clickable bucket. The consumers treat a missing map like a missing entry: no drill (the tile's rule in PR #30634).
- One exception, kept on purpose: a report answer with no `object` (a server older than ADR-0021 D2) still hands `ReportView` its group-key fallback drill, unchanged, as `drill: omits objectFilter when the server returns no drill metadata (older server)` pins.

## Tests

On `f9543126` (the head):

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-report/`: Test Files 33 passed (33), Tests 313 passed, 7 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-dashboard/`: Test Files 203 passed (203), Tests 1957 passed, 6 skipped. VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-report --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` each): VERDICT command-exit 0.
- New pins, each a top-level `describe` in a shared harness:
  - `plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.test.tsx`, "measure drill scopes (#30615)": a filtered measure cell carries its scope; a `{}` cell carries bucket and report scope only; a derived measure offers no drill; an answer with an object and no `drillScopes` offers no drill; a line of one filtered measure drills as a line with its scope; a matrix cell carries its measure's scope and a no-entry measure's cell is not clickable.
  - `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.test.tsx`, "table drill — measure drill scopes (#30615)": the same five table cases plus the cross-tab cell, asserting the `$filter` the drawer's list sends.
  - `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.chartBucketIdentity.test.tsx`, "chart drill — measure drill scopes (#30615)": a filtered series bar, a `{}` series bar, a no-entry series (opens nothing) and an answer with no `drillScopes` (no click handler).
- Existing drill fixtures gained a `drillScopes` entry of `{}` for their measures (17 test files), which is what a current server answers for a plain measure; their assertions are unchanged.

<details><summary>Ablations (two, one per package, on the scope leg)</summary>

Both through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` under the verify lock, replacing `  return composeDrillFilter(runtimeFilter, scope);` with `  return runtimeFilter;` (anchor 1 to 0 each), restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to source, so there is no dist leg.

- `plugin-dashboard/src/measureDrill.ts` (blob db75569cbe8d to 902425afed01, re-run on `f9543126`): Tests 4 failed, 74 passed over `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` and `DatasetWidget.chartBucketIdentity.test.tsx`: the filtered bar, the filtered table cell, the one-scope row, the cross-tab cell.
- `plugin-report/src/measureDrillScope.ts` (blob 3ada35c7e701 to e47abefae51b): Tests 3 failed, 48 passed over `DatasetReportRenderer.test.tsx`: the filtered cell, the one-scope line, the matrix cell.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The drawer's "Open in list" escape hatch still widens a filtered-measure drill (not fixed here, outside the file surface).** Measured live on the same cell after this change: the drawer lists 0 records, and "Open in list" navigates to `showcase_invoice/data?filter[issued_on][gte]=2026-08-07&filter[issued_on][lte]=2026-11-05&filter[status]=sent`, which lists the 4 sent invoices. `serializeDrillFilterParams` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/drillUrlFilters.ts`) writes one URL param per field with `params.set`, so the scope's `status = paid` is overwritten by the bucket's `status = sent`, and a list comparand (`$in`, `$nin`) is skipped. Reported to the seat for a card.
- `ReportView`'s group-key fallback is now reached only for a report answer with no `object`; it is unchanged.
- The two small helpers are deliberately package-local copies: a shared one belongs in `@object-ui/core`, which this claim keeps read only.
- `drillRawTotals` is not passed through `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: no totals row or total cell drills on any of these surfaces, so nothing reads it.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live: app-showcase Revenue Pulse (filtered), table "Paid Rate by Status", en-US, 1440 wide</summary>

`objectstack dev --fresh --seed-admin` app-showcase plus the Console vite dev server. The answer's `drillScopes`: `{ invoice_count: {}, paid_count: { status: 'paid' } }`, no `paid_rate` entry. Rows: Paid (Invoices 3, Paid Invoices 3, Paid Rate 100.0%), Sent (4, 0, 0.0%). The seed has no `open` status; the Sent row is the card's case.

Before (`14c67d44`, main with PR #30634): both rows carry `dataset-drill-row`. Every cell of the Sent row opens the same list, `issued_on` window AND `status = sent`: 4 records, all `sent`, including under Paid Invoices (number 0) and Paid Rate.

After (`ca694112`; the one later commit `f9543126` only drops a duplicate type alias): no row carries `dataset-drill-row`; Invoices and Paid Invoices cells carry `dataset-drill-cell`, Paid Rate cells none.

- Sent / Paid Invoices (0): list filter window AND `status = paid` AND `status = sent`: 0 records.
- Sent / Invoices (4), the unfiltered control: window AND `status = sent`: 4 records, all `sent`.
- Paid / Paid Invoices (3): 3 records, all `paid`. Paid / Invoices (3): 3 records.
- Paid Rate (derived): no drawer opens.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates on f9543126</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 35 families on `f9543126` (the same list as on `ca694112`). Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe; all 35 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Also `pnpm --dir ui run check:spec-symbols`: exit 0.

The first pass, on `ca694112`, was red on one family: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` failed `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, because both new helpers declared a type named `MeasureDrillScope`. `f9543126` removes the dashboard's alias (plugin-report keeps the name); the family re-ran green there (Test Files 170 passed, 2 skipped; Tests 4970 passed), and the 34 other families re-ran on `f9543126` too.

Families CI runs are read from this PR's check-runs.

</details>

Branch: `claude/project-thread-8u6mg4` is the card thread's platform-assigned branch (claim 6667494492, amendment 6667568430), not the `claude/issue-30615-*` convention.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
